data.name: Gulfan
data.gender_notes: Gulfan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘gul-’, meaning ‘lotus’, and the suffix ‘-fan’, meaning ‘bud’. This name signifies the opening of the lotus bud, symbolizing new beginnings and enlightenment. The name Gulfan carries the meaning “Lotus Bud” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gulfan usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus bud and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual awakening of an individual.
data.etymology: Gulfan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus Bud.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gulfan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
